# AK's Elite Dental Clinic & Orthodontic Centre | Madurai

> Premier dental clinic and orthodontic specialty centre located in K.Pudur, Madurai, Tamil Nadu. Led by Dr. Khalidh Khan (BDS, MDS - Orthodontist & Dentofacial Orthopedist). Rated 4.9 ★ with 105+ verified Google reviews.

## Core Services & Clinical Specialties

- [3D Invisible Clear Aligners & Orthodontic Braces](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Custom digital clear aligners, ceramic braces, and self-ligating brackets for adults & teenagers.
- [Single-Sitting Painless Root Canal Treatment (RCT)](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Computerized rotary endodontics with apex locators and digital imaging for single-visit tooth preservation.
- [Lifetime Titanium Dental Implants](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Permanent titanium osseointegrated dental implants for single, multi-tooth, and full mouth fixed teeth restoration.
- [Cosmetic Smile Design & Teeth Whitening](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Porcelain veneers, composite bonding, and in-office LED teeth whitening.
- [Gentle Pediatric Dentistry](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Fear-free child dental care, cavity prevention, fluoridation, and preventive orthodontics.
- [Gum Health & Laser Periodontics](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#treatments): Advanced painless ultrasonic scaling, gum therapy, and breath freshening.

## Clinical Leadership & E-E-A-T Credentials

- [Dr. Khalidh Khan (Chief Specialist)](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#doctor): BDS (2014), MDS (2018) in Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics from Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences (RGUHS), Bengaluru. Over 9+ years of private clinical practice experience with 25,000+ patients treated, 10,000+ braces cases, and 1,000+ clear aligners.
- [Smile Gallery & Verified Cases](https://www.aksdentalclinic.in/#transformations): Photographic proof of ectopic canine correction, gap closures, deep bite leveling, and cosmetic makeovers.
